subject: SOC 2 + DPA + Pen-test: Sprint-window walkthrough availability
messages:
From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@cleartrail.com>
Cc: ben.carter@redwood.ai, olga.petrov@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2029 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: SOC 2 + DPA + Pen-test: Sprint-window walkthrough availability

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for the time on Friday. Per our conversation, we'd like to run a single 75–90 minute compliance walkthrough that covers three items in one go to reduce back-and-forth:

- SOC 2 readiness review (scope, controls mapping, expected artifacts)
- DPA redline overview and data flow discussion
- Pen-test scoping and our vendor handoff process

Proposed windows (all PT):
- Tue Jun 25: 09:30–11:00 or 16:00–17:30
- Wed Jun 26: 11:00–12:30 or 18:00–19:30 (we can offer an evening slot for APAC folks)

Please tell me which of the above works, and who from your side will join (Security, Legal, Procurement). I can include our pen-test lead and one of our engineering on-call folks.

I've attached the current SOC 2 questionnaire (stub) and the DPA draft v3 for your review so you have materials ahead of the call. Also linking our mutual action plan: https://redwood-demo.s3/cleartrail/mutual-action-plan

Attachments: SOC2-questionnaire.xlsx (spreadsheet stub), DPA-draft-v3.pdf (PDF stub)

Thanks — happy to compress into a 60-minute slot if you'd prefer a high-level pass first.

—Nikhil
Nikhil Sharma
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
nikhil@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0127

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@cleartrail.com>

Date: Mon, 17 Jun 2029 20:05:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 + DPA + Pen-test: Sprint-window walkthrough availability

Thanks Nikhil — this looks good. We want to include:
- Our Lead SecOps (Jamie H.)
- One person from Legal (Maria) to watch the DPA section
- Procurement on standby for pricing/terms questions

We have some constraints next week: Tue morning is tough for our engineering leads. Wed Jun 26 18:00–19:30 ET (which I think is 15:00–16:30 PT) would work best for our team. Could you confirm the expected attendees on your side and whether you record the session?

Also a couple quick questions up front:
1) For the pen-test scoping, do you have a preferred vendor list or do we bring our own?
2) Is there anything in the SOC 2 questionnaire that you want us to prioritize completing before the walkthrough?

Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 01:10:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 + DPA + Pen-test: Sprint-window walkthrough availability

Alex — great, Wed Jun 26 evening works for us. To confirm logistics:

- Final slot: Wed Jun 26 • 18:00–19:30 ET (15:00–16:30 PT) — I'll send a calendar invite when you confirm attendees.
- Redwood attendees: me (SE), Ben Carter (Sales lead), Olga Petrov (Security engineering), plus our pen-test lead (remote) — total of 4 on our side.
- We record walkthroughs for internal follow-up but will not share recording externally without permission; if you'd like us to refrain from recording, say the word.

To answer your questions:
1) Pen-test vendor — we regularly work with three preferred vendors; we can either run with one of ours (we handle contracting) or accept your vendor if you'd rather manage that relationship. If you already have a vendor in mind, send name + contact and we'll coordinate.
2) SOC 2 priority — the Controls Mapping tab in the questionnaire is the most useful to fill first (access provisioning + encryption controls). We'll review whatever you complete and focus the walkthrough on gaps.

I've attached the DPA draft link and added a short mutual action plan to outline milestones (review, redlines, signature, pen-test kickoff). Link: https://redwood-demo.s3/cleartrail/mutual-action-plan

Attachments: DPA-draft-v3.pdf (stub)

If you prefer, we can shorten to 60 minutes and then run a focused follow-up on pen-test scoping only. Otherwise we'll budget for the full 90 to leave time for Q&A.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Nikhil
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@cleartrail.com>, secops@cleartrail.com

Date: Tue, 18 Jun 2029 01:25:00 +00:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 + DPA + Pen-test: Sprint-window walkthrough availability

Alex / team — thanks for confirming Wed the 26th evening ET. I've tentatively blocked the time on our side and will send a calendar invite from Redwood once Alex confirms the final attendee list. For clarity: we'll bring a short agenda (20m SOC 2 overview, 25m DPA/Q&A, 30–40m pen-test scoping).

If Procurement wants to pre-send any standard SOW/PO language to speed contracting, feel free to loop that in.

See you next week — Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
